heading: Where each file goes
body:
Pages are in client/pages. Components are in client/components. Services are in client/services. Backend controllers are in server/controllers. A controller is a class that answers HTTP requests. A page contains components. A component is a tac.html view and an optional tac.css file. Behaviour is in a service class. The view refers to that class by name. Shared browser assets, data and scripts are in client/shared, and Tac utility classes are in client/shared/utils.

Every other class goes in the folder of its role, in client/ for the page and in server/ for the server: models, remotes (HTTP clients), stores, setups, entities, helpers, converters and tests. A role folder may hold nested folders. The server also has roles for the role types of `@Allow`, errors for application error types, utils for utility classes, shared for plain code, workers, and packages for the vendored Go module.
